01_pairs.label: §5.2 full rewrite
01_pairs.old:
**P2/S1 (exact permutation on label-free scores).** G(d) and D̄ (d) are computed under protocol (c), a score function of (d, 𝔻{d}) that never consults regime labels. Under H0 ("all documents generated by one process; labels arbitrary"), the score vector is exchangeable across label assignments, so permuting labels over the FIXED score vector is an exact randomization test. This **fixes a flaw in v1's H3b**, where regime-specific held- out profiles were permuted at document level although the scores themselves depended on the labels — subtly invalid; corrected here by construction.

**LODO composition note.** Removing d from the pooled training pool shifts pool composition slightly against d's own regime. Under H0 this is irrelevant (one process). Under H1 it *dilutes* G-differences conservatively (each doc is scored against a background under-representing its regime). Stated as a conservative bias, not corrected.

**P1 (exact sign-flip).** Under H0, "own" and "other" training pools are equally sized (T*-matched) samples of documents from the same process, so CE(d|own) and CE(d|other) are identically distributed and ΔCE(d) is symmetric about 0; sign-flip over documents is the exact test. Seed-averaging before flipping is legitimate (seeds are internal replicates).

**Why no refit-per-permutation:** a fully refit permutation (462 × all fits) is unnecessary given the label-free construction, and would cost ≈ 10² laptop-hours for no additional validity.
01_pairs.new:
**P2/S1 (exact permutation on label-free scores).** G(d) and D̄(d) are computed under protocol (c), a score function of (d, 𝔻 ∖ {d}) that never consults regime labels. Under H0 ("all documents generated by one process; labels arbitrary"), the score vector is exchangeable across label assignments, so permuting labels over the FIXED score vector is an exact randomization test. This **fixes a flaw in v1's H3b**, where regime-specific held-out profiles were permuted at document level although the scores themselves depended on the labels — subtly invalid; corrected here by construction. Requirement: joint exchangeability of the label-free score vector — guaranteed by the construction (D36(i) stands).

**LODO composition note (relabeled by D44(iv)).** Removing d from the pooled training pool shifts pool composition against d's own regime, and the shift is **asymmetric between regimes**: a HEX document is scored against a 4+6 pool, a PROSE document against a 5+5 pool, and in tokens the disparity is larger because the Iliad dominates the HEX side. Under H0 this is irrelevant (one process; exchangeability holds → test validity unaffected). Under H1, to the extent that gain increases with own-regime representation in the training pool, it is a **directional displacement of the group difference, not a symmetric shrinkage**: it exaggerates G_HEX < G_PROSE and compresses the opposite — P2 is two-sided (D33) precisely because direction is never assumed. The earlier label "conservative dilution" is withdrawn; effect-size interpretation carries this caveat. Mitigation (binding, D44(iv)): `pooled_scores` reports per document the own-regime token fraction of its training subsample (seed-mean), audited and displayed alongside T3.

**P1 (exact sign-flip) — validity status: OPEN (D44/O7; blocking G2/G5).** Under H0, T*-matched "own" and "other" pools are samples from the same process, so ΔCE(d) is **marginally** symmetric about 0 (D36(ii), which stands). Exactness of the sign-flip, however, requires invariance of the **joint** law of {ΔCE(d)} under coordinatewise sign changes — not implied by the construction: for each seed, the eleven documents' training material is drawn from heavily overlapping pools, so a sampling fluctuation that makes one pool more "typical" induces a common-mode component, coherent in sign within regime and opposite across regimes; with n = 11 it does not average out and cannot be generated by independent flips → risk of an **anti-conservative null**. Seed-averaging reduces subsampling variance but not pool-composition variance, increasing the common mode's relative weight. Resolution before G2 (O7): a null-calibration study on synthetic data runs the full chain under a true H0 and measures the empirical type-I error at nominal levels, with P2's permutation as positive control; named remedies if inflation is found: document-level refit randomization at reduced S, or an alternative pre-specified scheme validated on synthetics (D44(v)). The generic sign-flip utility is still implemented and tested at G0 (D44(vi)).

**Refit-per-permutation (corrected by D44(iii)).** The "no refit needed" argument holds for P2 — the scores are label-free, so refitting under relabeling is genuinely unnecessary. For P1 it is **inverted**: ΔCE depends on labels by definition, and refit-under-relabeling is precisely what would purchase exactness. Corrected cost: ≈ 13 fits per relabeling per seed → 462 × 13 × S; at S = 20 ≈ 1.2 × 10⁵ fits (≈ 33–100 laptop-hours at 1–3 s/fit [ASSUMPTION → O6 at G3]); a reduced-S null lowers this by an order at a declared, conservative cost. Whether a refit scheme is adopted is decided by the O7 calibration outcome.

**D42 — Sensitivity-plan partition (parametric robustness vs representation analysis).** **Q:** D37 required sign-stability "across all 13 cells" for any conclusion, treating representation changes as robustness conditions. **Decision:** the 13 cells are partitioned. **(i) Parametric-robustness block** = C0 + the 7 OAT cells (β ∈ {1/|A|, 0.25, 1.0}; d_max ∈ {6, 12}; select = argmax; unrestricted gain): sign-stability across this block is **required** for any substantive conclusion; instability inside it is itself a reported finding. **(ii) Representation-analysis block** = the 5 non-C0 factorial cells (alphabet policy × boundary): these change the observed object; their outcomes are **reported and interpreted, never used as automatic validity conditions** (e.g., an effect present under ud23 and absent under upos_only localizes the signature in the dependency information — a finding, not a robustness failure). **D43 ★ — Sidedness declared for every exact floor; Tier-2 status; Lysias-merged status; author-block aggregation.** **Q:** attainable minima were declared without sidedness; D21's Tier-2 floor (0.05) is the one-sided permutation floor while P2 is two-sided (D33); the Lysias-merged rerun and the author-level statistic were procedurally under-specified. **Decision:** **(i) General rule (binding):** every declared floor states its sidedness. The two-sided floor equals **twice** the one-sided floor **only when the randomization orbit contains the sign-mirror of the observed configuration**: always for sign-flips; for label permutations **only with equal group sizes**. With unequal groups no mirror is guaranteed and the two-sided floor coincides with the one-sided floor (attained when the observed assignment uniquely maximizes |T|). **(ii) Declared floors:**

| Scheme | Enumeration | One-sided floor | Two-sided floor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Greek P1 sign-flip | 2^11 = 2048 | 1/2048 ≈ 0.00049 (primary) | 2/2048 ≈ 0.00098 |
| Greek P2 label perm. (5/6, unequal) | C(11,5) = 462 | 1/462 ≈ 0.0022 | 1/462 ≈ 0.0022 (coincides) |
| Latin P1 sign-flip | 2^8 = 256 | 1/256 ≈ 0.0039 | 2/256 ≈ 0.0078 |
| Latin P2 label perm. (2/6, unequal) | C(8,2) = 28 | 1/28 ≈ 0.036 | 1/28 ≈ 0.036 (coincides) |
| Author P1 sign-flip | 2^6 = 64 | 1/64 ≈ 0.0156 | 2/64 ≈ 0.031 |
| Author P2 label perm. (3/3, equal) | C(6,3) = 20 | 1/20 = 0.05 | **2/20 = 0.10 (operative)** |
| Lysias-merged P2 label perm. (5/3, unequal) | C(8,3) = 56 | 1/56 ≈ 0.018 | 1/56 ≈ 0.018 (coincides) |

Rationale: consistency with unweighted document means at Tier 1; token-weighting would re-introduce size dependence. **(vi) O2 coupling (→ O8):** the 3/3 partition {Homer, Hesiod, Hymn-anon} vs {Herodotus, Thucydides, Lysias} underlies C(6,3) = 20 and 2^6 = 64. **D44 ★ — Sign-flip validity for P1: OPEN question, blocking G2/G5; amendments to D36 (ii)–(iv); Gate G2 repositioned.** **Q:** D36(ii) argued the exact sign-flip from the marginal symmetry of ΔCE(d) under H0. **Decision:** **(i) Gap identified:** exactness of the sign-flip requires invariance of the **joint** law of {ΔCE(d)} under coordinatewise sign changes (sufficient condition: independent, individually symmetric components). The construction yields **marginal** symmetry only. Mechanism: for each seed, the "own"/"other" training material of the eleven documents is drawn from two heavily overlapping document pools; a sampling fluctuation that makes one pool more "typical" induces a **common-mode component**, coherent in sign within regime and opposite across regimes; with n = 11 it does not average out and cannot be generated by independent flips → risk: **anti-conservative null**. Seed-averaging reduces subsampling variance but not pool-composition variance (the documents are fixed), so it *increases* the relative weight of the common mode. **(ii) P1/P2 asymmetry (declared):** P2's permutation requires only joint exchangeability of the label-free score vector — guaranteed by construction (D36(i) stands). P1's sign-flip requires a strictly stronger condition **not implied** by the construction; the final proposal itself flags the assumption and assigns it to statistical supervision (§§6.6, 6.11 → 11.1). **(iii) D36(iv) corrected:** the "no refit-per-permutation" cost argument holds for P2 (scores label-free) and is **inverted** for P1 (ΔCE depends on labels by definition; refit-under-relabeling is precisely what would purchase exactness). Corrected cost: ≈ 13 fits per relabeling per seed (11 own-LODO + 2 group models) → 462 × 13 × S; at S = 20 ≈ 1.2 × 10⁵ fits (≈ 33–100 laptop-hours at 1–3 s/fit [ASSUMPTION → O6 at G3]); a reduced-S null lowers this by an order at a declared, conservative cost. **(iv) D36(iii) relabeled:** the LODO composition shift is **asymmetric between regimes** (a HEX document is scored against a 4+6 pool, a PROSE document against a 5+5 pool; in tokens the disparity is larger because the Iliad dominates the HEX side). To the extent that gain increases with own-regime representation in the training pool, the shift is a **directional displacement of the group difference, not a symmetric shrinkage**: it exaggerates G_HEX < G_PROSE and compresses the opposite — and P2 is two-sided (D33) precisely because direction is never assumed. The label "conservative dilution" is **withdrawn**. Validity is unaffected (under H0 exchangeability holds); effect-size interpretation is affected. **Mitigation (binding):** `pooled_scores` reports, per document, the own-regime token fraction of its training subsample (seed-mean); audited and displayed alongside T3. **(v) Resolution path (O7, blocking):** pre-G2 **null-calibration study on synthetic data only**: generate from a single process (H0 true); split into 11 pseudo-documents matching the corpus size profile (available after G1); assign the observed labels; run the **full chain** (LODO, T\*-matching, seed-averaging, sign-flip); estimate the empirical type-I error at nominal levels over replications; P2's permutation as positive control (must calibrate; failure = implementation bug, not theory). Deliverables: calibration report + mathematical-supervisor touchpoint with numbers. Named remedies if inflation is found: (a) document-level refit randomization for P1 at reduced S (declared, conservative); (b) an alternative pre-specified scheme validated on synthetics before G2. **(vi) Freeze rule:** the generic `exact_sign_flip` utility **is** implemented and tested at G0 on synthetic symmetric inputs; D44 blocks only the **confirmatory application to P1** (its freezing at G2 and its execution at G5). **(vii) Gate repositioning (structural consequence):** since O7 requires the implemented tree (Phase 2) and G2 is blocked on O7, **G2 moves after G3**: v2.1 execution order **G0 → G1 → G3 → G2 → G4 → G5 → G6 → G7**. Status: **OPEN — BLOCKING for G2 and G5** (tracked as O7); clauses (iv), (vi), (vii) FROZEN.

Every site is determined by a parallel occurrence or immediate context; none required discretionary reconstruction; italic emphasis is irrecoverable and non-normative. Full before/after table: `RESTAURO_01_MASTER_SPEC.md`. Status: EXECUTED (v2.1 re-issue).

**D49 — P2 estimand clarified; descriptive own-regime gain `G_own`; locus-claim wording.** **Q:** G(d) is the gain of the **pooled** model. A lower hexameter gain admits two readings — flatter conditional structure in the regime, or greater distance of the regime from the pooled mixture (the latter overlapping with what P1 measures). P2 alone does not separate them; §1.2's claim that P1 and P2 "target the two distinct claims" overstated separation; the locus thesis (root/gain/transfer) is affected. **Decision:** (i) §1.2/§4.4 reworded: P2 is the **pooled-model** context-gain differential; the confound is stated where P2 is defined. (ii) **New descriptive reading (no α): `G_own(d)`** = seed-mean over positions with `available_past ≥ 4` of `codelen_root − codelen_selected` under the **protocol-(b) own-regime LODO model** — **zero additional fits** (protocol-(b) evaluations already record `codelen_root`). It depends on regime labels by construction → **descriptive only, never permuted, outside the Holm family** (fully compatible with D36/D21). Reported alongside P2 (T3 descriptive columns) and in F5 (curves under both pooled and own-regime models, labeled). (iii) **Claim wording (extends D25):** pooled-gain conclusions are stated "under the pooled model"; any locus claim about sequential organization requires the joint reading of P2 **and** descriptive `G_own` (e.g., "hexameter shows lower gain also under its own model" vs "only under the pooled model"). Status: FROZEN.

**D50 — GATE-A × C0 reconciliation.** **Q:** D06 escalates to "both policies co-primary" if any excluded category exceeds 2% of raw tokens in a regime; D37/D42 presuppose a single primary configuration; the interaction was unspecified — and vocatives (epic invocations) are the plausible trigger. **Decision:** if GATE-A fires, **C0 remains the unique primary** (ud23, drop); the Holm family remains {P1, P2} on C0 only; **no cells are added** beyond the 13. Amends: D06 (escalation semantics). Status: FROZEN (trigger GATED:G1).

**D51 — T\* scope and the uniform-size argument.** **Q:** §4.2 defined T\* as the minimum over "ALL training conditions in (b) and (c)" without stating whether exploratory arms enter, and adopted one T\* across (b) and (c) without argument — although protocol (c)'s ten-document pool could support a larger size, i.e., the uniform choice costs P2 power, while §1.2 declares power the binding constraint. **Decision:** (i) **Scope:** T\* is computed over the training conditions of the **primary contrast only** (Greek: HEX ∪ PROSE_CLASS; Latin: HEX ∪ PROSE_ALL), protocols (b) and (c). Exploratory arms (tragedy, PROSE_POST) run at their own binding sizes, documented separately and labeled non-comparable with primary readings. (ii) **Uniform T\* across (b) and (c): retained, now argued** — it purchases cross-reading comparability (root/gain/transfer at one common training size: the locus narrative) at a **declared cost of P2 power**; the cost is made visible descriptively by the learning curves (F8), whose protocol-(c) curves extend beyond T\* where the pool permits. (iii) Binding condition: protocol (b) → "HEX minus Iliad" (expected); protocol (c) → 𝔻 minus its largest document; the overall minimum is expected from (b). The §4.2 contingency (T\* < 15k → logged amendment + learning-curve emphasis) stands. Status: FROZEN (value GATED:G1).
